title: Mona Gallery
tagline: Mona gallery is the gallery where users can surf and showcase NFTs to others.
description: The Mona gallery is an innovative platform that allows users to explore and showcase their NFTs in a visually stunning and immersive 3D environment. Built on the cutting-edge Mona verse technology and developed within the powerful Unity and mona sdk, this gallery offers a seamless and captivating experience for NFT enthusiasts. Users can effortlessly connect their wallets and have their NFTs automatically imported into the gallery, providing an elegant and organized display of their digital asset collection.
how_its_made: The gallery is crafted using the Mona SDK, which enables seamless integration. This integration allows users to fetch and display their NFTs from multiple chains, ensuring a comprehensive representation of their digital assets. Furthermore, the roadmap includes plans to implement a minting feature, empowering users to create and showcase their own unique NFTs within the gallery.
